Initial release of pozzzi-charity-management-advisor.

- Introduced as an open-source charity management advisor tool (v0.1.0).
- Provides community-maintained guidance and support for charitable organizations.
- Includes strict usage constraints to protect minors, prevent misuse, and ensure compliance.
- Requires all AI-generated content to be human-reviewed before use.
- Does not access or store user data; user provides their own compliant model API.
- Not suitable for legal, financial, or fundraising document generation.
